comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This is currently an unreleased accessory which, for Japanese players at least, was part of a "treasure box" Gran Atlas subscription bonus pack. Stats:

Jewellry trading +2
Textile trading +2
Sociability +1
Effect: Formality enhancement (+15)

Sources: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?BoostItem/mer1 (stats), www.gamecity.ne.jp/dol/gran_atlas/product_info.htm (Gran Atlas product details)
